definition: A T follicular helper cell that has differentiated into a long-lived, antigen-experienced memory state, characterised by a CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive phenotype. It retains expression of the B-cell-follicle-homing chemokine receptor CXCR5 (PMID:11104798), the transcriptional repressor BCL6, and the co-stimulatory and co-inhibitory surface receptors ICOS (PMID:11104798) and PD-1 (PMID:28637884) in humans. It persists in secondary lymphoid organs after resolution of a germinal-centre response and retains the capacity to recall follicular helper functions — including promotion of B-cell immunoglobulin class-switching and production — upon antigen re-encounter (PMID:25699040; PMID:29018187).

logical_axioms.notes: Second parent: memory Tfh cells are a subtype of both T follicular helper cells (primary parent CL:0002038) and CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cells (CL:0000897), integrating the follicular-helper specialisation with the antigen-experienced memory state.
CXCR5 surface expression is the canonical defining marker of the Tfh lineage and is retained on memory Tfh cells; established by flow cytometry at the protein level (PMID:11104798, PMID:11104797).

PD-1 (PDCD1) is expressed at high levels on the surface of human tonsillar Tfh cells, including the memory compartment, and is a defining marker of the Tfh phenotype at the protein level (PMID:28637884, PMID:30030323).

ICOS is highly expressed on the surface of human tonsillar Tfh cells at the protein level and is part of the canonical Tfh surface marker programme retained on memory Tfh (PMID:11104798, PMID:28637884).

The defining functional capacity of memory Tfh cells is to provide B-cell help that promotes immunoglobulin class-switching and production upon recall; directly demonstrated by co-culture with tonsillar B cells (PMID:11104797, PMID:25699040).
Memory Tfh cells have undergone the T follicular helper-to-memory transition and retain the capacity to re-differentiate into effector Tfh on antigen re-encounter (PMID:25699040; PMID:29018187).

justification: CL:0002038 (T follicular helper cell) captures the core Tfh identity (CD4+, CXCR5+, CCR7-, BCL6-high, ICOS-high, PD1-high, follicle-resident, B-cell helper) but does not encode the antigen-experienced memory/persistence state that defines this atlas population. The atlas cell type is explicitly CD45RA-negative and CD45RO-positive, persists after a germinal-centre response, and retains the capacity to recall follicular helper effector functions on antigen re-encounter — properties absent from the CL:0002038 definition. No CL term for a memory T follicular helper cell currently exists. The new term should be placed as a child of both CL:0002038 (T follicular helper cell, primary parent, providing follicular-helper specialisation) and CL:0000897 (CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell, second parent, providing the memory/antigen-experienced identity). The location axiom for palatine tonsil is not proposed as a subClassOf restriction because memory Tfh cells are found in multiple secondary lymphoid organs and also circulate in blood (Asrir et al. 2017); the tonsil is the tissue context of the atlas but not a defining anatomical restriction for the cell type.

**Additional notes or concerns**
This term fills a gap in CL: no existing term captures a T follicular helper cell in the antigen-experienced memory state. The atlas population (Azimuth human_tonsil_v2, built on King et al. 2021, PMID:34623901) is annotated as memory Tfh based on CD45RA-negative/CD45RO-positive phenotype combined with the canonical Tfh marker programme.

The new term should sit under two parents:
1. CL:0002038 (T follicular helper cell) — primary parent, providing follicular-helper specialisation
2. CL:0000897 (CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell) — second parent, providing memory/antigen-experienced identity

Note that CL:0002038 is currently classified under the exhausted T cell branch (CL:0020030) in addition to helper T cell; editors may wish to review whether the memory Tfh should inherit that placement.

Proposed logical axioms:
- subClassOf 'CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell' (CL:0000897)
- subClassOf 'has plasma membrane part' some 'C-X-C chemokine receptor type 5' (PR:000001209)
- subClassOf 'has plasma membrane part' some 'programmed cell death protein 1' (PR:000001919)
- subClassOf 'has plasma membrane part' some 'inducible T-cell costimulator' (PR:000001860)
- subClassOf 'capable of' some 'positive regulation of immunoglobulin production' (GO:0002639)
- subClassOf 'capable of' some 'memory T cell differentiation' (GO:0043379)

Note on BCL6: BCL6 is an intracellular transcription factor; it is mentioned in the definition textually but is not proposed as a plasma membrane axiom.

Note on location axiom: A 'part of' some palatine tonsil (UBERON:0002373) axiom is not proposed because memory Tfh cells are found in multiple secondary lymphoid organs and in circulating blood (PMID:29018187); the tonsil is the atlas context, not a biological restriction.
